description: This Java class 'EntityFieldValue' represents a field value expression used in constructing database query conditions within the OFBiz framework. It manages field names, entity aliases, and SQL generation logic for entity views and standard entities.

classes.name: EntityFieldValue
classes.description: Represents a field value in entity conditions, supporting SQL generation and view entity handling within OFBiz.

methods.name: makeFieldValue
methods.description: Creates an EntityFieldValue instance with a specified field name, optionally with entity alias and view entity context.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the EntityFieldValue with field name, entity alias, alias stack, and view entity.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on field name, entity alias, alias stack, and view entity.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another EntityFieldValue object.

methods.name: getModelField
methods.description: Retrieves the ModelField corresponding to the field name and view context.

methods.name: setModelField
methods.description: Stub method for setting the model field, logs info.

methods.name: addSqlValue
methods.description: Generates SQL snippet for the field, considering view entities and aliases.

methods.name: validateSql
methods.description: Validates that the field exists in the given model entity.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the field from a given map or entity.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Returns the current object as an immutable condition value.
